title: Sections of the inverse image to a directed limit of spectral spaces over a quasi-compact open are a colimit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set (nonempty, any two elements have a common upper bound), let $(X_i)_{i\in I}$ be spectral spaces [def-weil-spectral-space] and for $i\le i'$ let $f_{ii'}:X_{i'}\to X_i$ be spectral maps (continuous, with $f_{ii'}^{-1}(W)$ quasi-compact for every quasi-compact open $W\subseteq X_i$), with $f_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$ and $f_{ii'}\circ f_{i'i''}=f_{ii''}$ for $i\le i'\le i''$. Let $X$ be a topological space with continuous maps $p_i:X\to X_i$, $f_{ii'}\circ p_{i'}=p_i$, which is a limit of the system in the category of topological spaces (the map $x\mapsto(p_i(x))_i$ is a bijection of $X$ onto $\{(x_i)\in\prod_iX_i: f_{ii'}(x_{i'})=x_i\text{ for }i\le i'\}$ and the topology of $X$ is the coarsest for which all $p_i$ are continuous). For a continuous map $h$ let $h^{-1}$ be the inverse image of sheaves of sets with unit $\eta^h$ on sections, as in [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (2), (3) with values in sets, and for continuous maps $h,h'$ let $c:h'^{-1}h^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}(h\circ h')^{-1}$ be the isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-inverse-image-composition]. Fix $i\in I$, a sheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $X_i$ and a quasi-compact open $U_i\subseteq X_i$. For $i'\ge i$ put $\mathcal G_{i'}=f_{ii'}^{-1}\mathcal G$ and $U_{i'}=f_{ii'}^{-1}(U_i)$ (so $p_{i'}^{-1}(U_{i'})=p_i^{-1}(U_i)$), let $\rho_{i'}:\mathcal G_{i'}(U_{i'})\to(p_i^{-1}\mathcal G)(p_i^{-1}U_i)$ be $c_{\mathcal G}\circ\eta^{p_{i'}}_{\mathcal G_{i'},U_{i'}}$ with $c:p_{i'}^{-1}f_{ii'}^{-1}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{\sim}(f_{ii'}\circ p_{i'})^{-1}\mathcal G=p_i^{-1}\mathcal G$, and for $i\le i'\le i''$ let $\rho_{i''i'}:\mathcal G_{i'}(U_{i'})\to\mathcal G_{i''}(U_{i''})$ be $c_{\mathcal G}\circ\eta^{f_{i'i''}}_{\mathcal G_{i'},U_{i'}}$ with $c:f_{i'i''}^{-1}f_{ii'}^{-1}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{\sim}f_{ii''}^{-1}\mathcal G$. Then (a) $\rho_{i''}\circ\rho_{i''i'}=\rho_{i'}$ and $\rho_{i'''i''}\circ\rho_{i''i'}=\rho_{i'''i'}$ for $i\le i'\le i''\le i'''$; (b) every $s\in(p_i^{-1}\mathcal G)(p_i^{-1}U_i)$ equals $\rho_{i'}(t)$ for some $i'\ge i$ and some $t\in\mathcal G_{i'}(U_{i'})$; (c) if $t,t'\in\mathcal G_{i'}(U_{i'})$ and $\rho_{i'}(t)=\rho_{i'}(t')$, then $\rho_{i''i'}(t)=\rho_{i''i'}(t')$ for some $i''\ge i'$. In other words $(p_i^{-1}\mathcal G)(p_i^{-1}U_i)=\varinjlim_{i'\ge i}(f_{ii'}^{-1}\mathcal G)(f_{ii'}^{-1}U_i)$.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma Tag 0A32 (label lemma-compute-pullback-to-limit, line 3565) with its proof, stated there for a cofiltered index category; a directed set is the special case used here; the transition maps of the colimit are the pullback maps composed with the canonical isomorphisms of Lemma Tag 008I
